turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay got a zero.
An answer to what? You haven't told me anything yet.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admit what, Hale? You've shown me nothing, and a Friday deadline isn't evidence. What do you have?
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Those are your two options, not mine. Check your own policy, because it doesn't say that, and I'm not choosing until I see what you have.
